<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="ZTdSNDxNwJ0eXUG6RcCV"> <mxGraphModel grid="1" page="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "erDiagram
 %% Central Fact Table
 Fact_Streams {
 int stream_id PK
 int user_id FK
 int content_id FK
 int date_id FK
 int device_id FK
 int location_id FK
 float duration_minutes
 float completion_percentage
 }

 %% 5 Dimension Tables (The points of the star)
 Dim_User {
 int user_id PK
 string username
 string subscription_tier
 }
 
 Dim_Content {
 int content_id PK
 string title
 string genre
 int release_year
 }
 
 Dim_Date {
 int date_id PK
 date full_date
 int month
 int year
 }
 
 Dim_Device {
 int device_id PK
 string device_type
 string os_version
 }
 
 Dim_Location {
 int location_id PK
 string city
 string state
 string country
 }

 %% Relationships radiating from Dimensions to the central Fact Table
 Dim_User ||--o{ Fact_Streams : \"streams\"
 Dim_Content ||--o{ Fact_Streams : \"is streamed\"
 Dim_Date ||--o{ Fact_Streams : \"occurs on\"
 Dim_Device ||--o{ Fact_Streams : \"is used for\"
 Dim_Location ||--o{ Fact_Streams : \"streamed from\"",
 "config": null
